title: Dimensionality Reduction and Manifold Learning
description: Techniques for feature space compression, multicollinearity elimination, and 2D/3D visualization.
conditions: Requirement to project complex feature spaces into 2D plots for exploratory discovery
recommended_methods: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for linear orthogonal variance decomposition
Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) for non-linear local/global structure preservation
t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) strictly for 2D exploratory cluster visualization
selection_rules: Always scale features with StandardScaler prior to applying PCA
Retain principal components that capture cumulative explained variance >= 85%
Never use t-SNE embeddings as input features for predictive models (use PCA or UMAP instead)
limitations: PCA components are linear combinations of all original features, making individual factor attribution difficult
t-SNE distances between distant clusters are meaningless and cluster sizes in t-SNE do not reflect true variance
